This chat runs over %1$s. The service’s end-to-end encryption ends at the bridge next to your GateControl server; stored there the messages are encrypted, and nobody but you sees this chat in GateControl.
What does not work here: pictures, files and voice messages (to follow), calls, status, disappearing messages and GateControl extras such as polls, events, home actions and cards.

A chat over another messenger does not take this – there are no GateControl extras such as polls, events or cards, and pictures, files and voice messages only with a GateControl server that carries them.
